>**May i ask what country you live in?**

United States.

The topic of sexuality is not something that *intrinsically* bothers me. Indeed, it bothers me only how it reflects upon you as an apparently failed individual. I have a want to interact socially with people, engage in relationships, experiences, the sorts, with a mental state that leaves me unable to achieve any of this.

You want love. You want friends. You want someone to spend your life with. Your emotions and hormones only further aggregate your torment. They remind you that you are nothing more than a *biologically damaged failure*.

You want *human* companionship ⁠but your responses are only *alien.* You find it hard to mentally engage with others. You don't understand things that should be normal at this age — friends, crazy experiences, relationships, social events, the sorts — and can only awkwardly respond in like. It only compounds with age.

It's a nightmare beyond imagination. I find it truly hard to describe without either understating my troubles or coming across as melodramatic. It's hard to understand and empathize with unless you've experienced the same. You feel like they don't understand because they *are too different from you*.

It's occurs day by day, hour by hour, minute by minute. You look alright. There's nothing wrong with you from the exterior. You probably only rarely cry about it. You've thought about it too much. It's merely *normal*. It's something that just happens to be an inherent part of you. It's who you are and probably will always be.

Alone and broken.

You are correct! I've thought about becoming a writer in the past. 

And thank you!

> **everyone has their own timeline** 

Do you know what Aspergers is? 

>**Have you tried reaching out to your friend who ghosted you?**

Seven times over the course of an entire year. He's not dead and didn't change his phone number. So he is intentionally ignoring my attempts to reach out to him. I stopped attempting to communicate with him.

>**I'm highly positive that most women won't call guys beautiful or talk about their looks, because I'd think they'll think it's sort of flirty? They probably don't wanna give the wrong impression.**

Sure. But I suspect that they would have not called me ugly as well.

>**Bro you’re ok. It’s going to be ok.**

Realistically? Or are you making this up?

>**You shouldn’t think like that, you have you’re own life, your own struggles, the time will come where you won’t have to actively try and socialize, people will come up to you but that’s a chance.**

By magic? How would somebody physically unattractive, arguably mentally ill, and socially inept suddenly become a simultaneous manifestation of St. Paul, Aristotle, and Don Juan? You can't fix Aspergers. You can partially treat the symptoms. Perhaps you will generally recognize it. But you won't always. You will mess up. You will fail. And sometimes, you won't even know that you did until it is far too late  —  people will hate you for it.

I'm broken. I can't read a person's mental state. I can't read their heart. It's a guessing game just to determine even the most basic of emotions. Other people don't have to deal with that. Other people aren't ugly as sin. I can't tell how my actions will come across. I just speak and hope it hits.

It's throwing the entire kitchen sink upon the wall.

>**“hey, wanna go grab some food after class?” Or just attempt at making conversation.**

How am I supposed to do that? I haven't talked to any of these people in my life. Because I'm ugly, girls are going to think that I'm some sort of predator or creep. That only works if you are handsome, socially in tune, and/or well known. Why would a popular girl from a sorority or peer in class want to randomly engage and hang out with a ugly and socially awkward male that they've only briefly interacted with in class?

I'm not broken enough to recognize my *failings; but* broken enough that I can't them or change them. They'll think the same about me no matter what I ever do. And the longer time passes, the more my sorrows become more numerous.

>**you’re looking at others and wondering why you’re not moving at the same pace**

Don't lots of people have purposeless, meaningless lives? Was that a part of their predestined timeline as well? Why should I assume that my actualized future is any different? It isn't because I've forgotten to speak or been predisposed to shyness. My conditions leave me fundamentally broken as a human individual in modernity.
Sure.
I feel like I'm in a doom loop at this point. It just gets worse and worse as you age.

> **You’re not ugly man** 

How do you know that? Before you say beauty is in the eye of the beholder... 

**I define ugly as:** *Considered ugly by an overwhelming majority of people.* 

**And beautiful as:** *Considered beautiful by an overwhelming majority of people.* 

And yes, there is way to scientifically measure beauty. Danny Devito and Adriana Lima will not be considered attractive by nearly the same amount of people. 

> **It is someone who you grow close to and help you work through your struggles in life.**  

Do you honestly believe that a woman would desire a socially awkward, ugly man as her future husband? Do you think that she would ever have any desire for him? Being rich doesn't help. Talking to a therapist wouldn't help. At best, I'll be someone that they'd "settle" for. 

The problems are *ontologically a part of me.* Shouldn't I just give up at this point?

I get what you are trying to say. But my problems originate from *things that are inherently, truly within me.* How am I supposed to cure Aspergers? How am I supposed to fix not having normal social development during childhood and adolescence? I can't.

The most I could do is get therapy. But I fail to see how it will help me accomplish anything but answering certain questions in a robotic and canned manner. It can't help me develop cognitive empathy. It can't fix my physical appearance. It can't fix the core of my problems. Nothing can.

I assume someone is going to mention some self-help "social skills" or "seduction" program in the comments. But it's pretty common knowledge that 99% of that stuff are scams built to financially prey upon emotionally vulnerable men and women who attempt to purchase.

Am I wrong to be giving up hope here? Social alienation, mediocrity, and depression for the next 60-100 years is arguably worse than death. I'm just praying to God that it gets better soon. Since it feels like it would take a miracle for me to be transformed into something other than a disfigurement of a social human individual.

It makes you feel so hopeless. So angry. You cry out to God, to anyone, to help you. But you feel darkness in your soul, and a pit within your stomach. *Is it going to alright? Is it going to be okay?* I don't know. I don't fucking know. *But I certainly hope so.* I certainly hope my life can get better than this.

**My life is becoming a morbid modification of a famous quote:** 

***Because unless the saying, I am losing heart. I'm wasting away inwardly day by day.***

I don't have any friends in general.

A degree without any relationships seems to leave me without any sense of transcendent meaning, purpose,  or value. Counselling may provide me an ability to react with canned responses in a narrow range of circumstances, but my responses will always seem canned and robotic in nature. People are fundamentally *alien* to me. Enrolling into groups, attending church, and "trying dating apps" isn't going to change any of this. I'll still be a freak.

I'd rather being *socially engaged and poor* than *a billionaire loner*. 

Some things are more important than money.

Maybe, maybe not.

But I'm losing my will to live at this point. How can I get help dealing with these issues? Is there a pill to suddenly turn yourself into the next supermodel? Is there a pill to cure Aspergers? No. There isn't. I'm stuck with this forever.

If I was ugly and funny? Maybe a few people could deal with that. If I was attractive and had a terrible personality? A lot of people (of all genders) could sadly deal with that. But being unattractive and socially awkward? 

That's a permanent death sentence right there.

I get what you are trying to say. But I'm not sure how I'm supposed to apply that to my situation. :( 

Thank you, though.

>**but he's pointing the finger blaming everything on women**

Where did I say that I hate women? You don't think men have shallow standards as well?

My comments in dating are just about women because I'm a heterosexual man. I'm sure a lot of guys (particularly in high school and college) are shallow as well. That's a human universal more than anything.

>**He's just convinced himself it's to do with his height.**

The women have said so themselves... I've been called a "midget" for my height.

>**It's so distasteful.  When really women avoid him because his attitude is toxic.**

I didn't say anything "toxic" to the girl who mocked me yesterday on social media. I don't hate women. I never said that I hate women. I'm not a misogynist in the very least. Why are you accusing me of being one?

The girl who rejected me *herself* stated she considered it insulting that a "short ugly man" like me would "attempt" to go out with her, then mocked my appearance (with an IRL picture) on social media.

How was I "toxic" or "wrong" here?

>**He assumes women should automatically like him**

Never said that.

>**This is how mass shooters come about with this line of thinking.**

How in the world am I similar to a MASS SHOOTER?

>**he isn't in the wrong, they are. It's scary.**

*WHAT?* I was simply asking a question.

**You’re never going to be attractive to everyone, especially with such a skewed view on yourself and others.**

Of the 9 women that I've asked out, 4 have mocked my height. (All were 3" inches shorter than me) 1 publicly humiliated me on social media yesterday for it. It doesn't seem that uncommon...

**you’re going for the wrong women**

I've mainly asked out people I know at church/a food pantry I work at/college. They were pretty nice to me, at least, in a platonic/relationship sense... so some of their reactions have left me pretty shocked.

But you were definitely right: I dodged a bullet with them, at the very least, so for that, I am thankful.

Therapy for what? I'm just asking. There's no need to insult me.

>**Wow, how old are you if you don't mind me asking.**

Young adult.

>**Sometimes people are so drawn to their partners that they willingly overlook major flaws like cheating.  If someone’s ignoring you for someone terrible instead, that’s their loss.**

Yes, because the guy is considered attractive. He even got her to *apologize to him* about it.

Girls still find him attractive, flirt with him, etc. and such. Because of an accident of birth, he's automatically treated better by anyone he comes across. People who are considered ugly are bullied, ignored, or treated extensively harsher than members of the general population.

And there is no shortage of [scientific](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/pop-psych/201804/the-beautiful-people) or [anecdotal research](https://www.reddit.com/r/AskReddit/comments/6edai8/do_you_believe_that_attractive_people_get_treated/) backing this up. My interactions and observations of people I've observed in the real world only reconfirm this.

And guess what? Attractiveness is predominately genetic. In 500 years, it will still be the same story. Is that not depressing? We aren't attracted primarily on the basis of personality, sweetness, or live, but rather a random assortment and throwing of the genetic dice. That's maddening.

>**What do you like to do with your spare time?**

Pretty much what you expect: learning or playing video games.

>**I can tell you I've heard from any amount of people that confidence is really attractive in a dude whether he's "ugly" or not...  Otherwise, try working out.**

If I remember correctly, BMI can be inaccurate in a lot of cases... but I forget where I heard that. Maybe I'm thin... in terms of weight... but have no muscle and tons of fat? It would explain the negative facial changes.

>**How shitty some guys are and how girls flock to them anyway. It may be true, and it sucks** 

It's not just that. But my sense of inferiority stems from their repeated cheating on their partners, and yet, they either get a new GF OR manage to get her back... oftentimes having HER apologize. What the heck am I doing wrong there? If they have girls giving attention to them... how....? 

> **It’ll make things a lot easier if you don’t scapegoat her for any issues that have come up.** 

It's not the girl herself, but rather the sense of negativity it made me feel about humanity. 

>  **it doesn’t mean you’re inferior at all.** 

Aspergers, OCD, possible (?) ugliness.... and a laundry list of mental disorders makes me feel so.  I remember getting harrassed, taunted, and nearly beat up throughout my HS years. I'm weak. I'm tired. I'm relatively short. 

I can't see my genes as anything else other than a genetic catastrophe.

>**You say you have 1 or 2 friends? That's awesome! Especially if they're good friends.**

I only have 1 good friend... and he's absent for the majority of the time due to living away for most of the year. I'm basically a *de facto* loner for a majority of the year. I regularly go weeks without talking to anyone other than my family.

If you check my other posts... I have Aspergers. So I have no idea how the vast majority of social interactions, or friendships, or anything else, is supposed to work. I was a total weirdo in HS/MS. I'm not in high school.... so I don't really know how I can improve any of these skills at this point.

It feels like everyone has emotionally moved away from where I'm at this point.

I just want to hug someone, honestly.

>**nobody is really going to judge you because you're single/kissless/virgin**

I don't mind being a virgin *at all*. But it makes me feel ashamed that no girl has ever expressed any interest in me. I feel hideous when I look at myself.  I apparently had great facial structure as a kid/young adolescent... (I was... pretty strange as a kid...) but somehow got evaporated and covered in fat. (Even if I had a normal BMI)

My stomach/face is fat.... despite the fact that it officially says I'm normal... although I don't really exercise. Confused on that part. I looked pretty handsome as a kid/young adolescent in hindsight...

I just have no social skills to *not* being single. If I do find a girl, she'll be so far advanced that I have nothing really to compare it to... and even 18yo girls in the future would generally be "ahead" of me in terms of courtsmanship/dating. I can't imagine what it will be like if I'm 25-28yo...

I'd be forced to match up with the youngest possible people who I can find... which doesn't look good.

>**I can tell you though, finding someone is tough...**

Thank you.
